map.η 通常在 0.85~0.95：完整硬岩、钻孔精度高时取 0.90~0.95，破: η is typically 0.85~0.95: take 0.90~0.95 for intact hard rock with high drilling accuracy, and around 0.85 or even lower for fractured zones and soft rock. Increasing the hole depth raises the per-cycle advance, but deep holes take longer to drill, the clamping effect is stronger, η often drops, and the longer cycle time reduces the number of cycles per day, so an optimal hole depth exists. Use this tool to compare 2~4 combinations of hole depth and process and take the one with the greatest daily advance.
map.→ 打开隧道掘进速度估算工具: -> Open the Tunnel Excavation Speed Estimation tool
map.为什么实际循环数常常小于我填写的计划循环数？: Why Is the Actual Cycle Count Often Less Than the Planned Cycle Count I Entered?
map.单循环进尺：循环进尺=炮孔深度×炮孔利用率 η（一般 0.85~0.95，由岩性: Per-cycle advance: cycle advance = blast hole depth × hole utilisation η (generally 0.85~0.95, determined by rock quality and drilling accuracy); increasing the hole depth raises the advance, but η usually falls accordingly.
map.因为工具取 min(计划循环数, floor(24÷单循环时间))。当五个工序耗: Because the tool takes min(planned cycle count, floor(24÷single-cycle time)). When the five process durations add up to a large total, the planned number simply does not fit in a day, and the bottleneck is the cycle time rather than the schedule. To speed things up, optimise the longest process: when drilling dominates, add rock drills or multi-boom rigs or switch to deep-hole blasting; when mucking dominates, increase hauling capacity and shorten the haul distance; when support dominates, separate the initial shotcrete temporary support from the permanent support added later.
map.循环时间与循环数：单循环时间=钻孔+爆破+通风+出渣+支护各工序耗时之和；时间允: Cycle time and cycle count: the single-cycle time = drilling + blasting + ventilation + mucking + support; the cycles the time allows = floor(24÷single-cycle time); the actual cycle count = min(planned cycle count, cycles allowed by time), that is, it is constrained by both the plan and the time.
map.炮孔利用率 η 一般取多少，加大孔深一定会更快吗？: What Value Should the Blast Hole Utilisation η Take, and Does a Deeper Hole Always Mean Faster?

map.输入炮孔深度、炮孔利用率（η 0.85~0.95）、循环作业时间等参数，估算钻爆: Enter the blast hole depth, the hole utilisation (η 0.85~0.95) and the cycle operation times to estimate the per-cycle advance, cycle time and daily advance of drill-and-blast, for tunnel construction organisation and schedule estimation.
map.进尺与工期：日进尺=单循环进尺×实际循环数，月进尺=日进尺×30；工具另按 10: Advance and schedule: daily advance = per-cycle advance × actual cycle count, monthly advance = daily advance × 30; the tool also estimates the schedule in months for a 1000 m single-heading drive as 1000÷daily advance÷30, which lets you compare the marginal benefit of different process combinations (such as adding rock drills to shorten drilling time or optimising mucking to shorten the cycle).
map.：输入：孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9、钻孔 3 h、爆破 1 h、通风 0.5: : input: hole depth 3 m, utilisation 0.9, drilling 3 h, blasting 1 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 3 h, support 2 h, planned cycle count 3 per day. Per-cycle advance = 3×0.9 = 2.70 m; single-cycle time = 3+1+0.5+3+2 = 9.50 h; cycles allowed by time = floor(24÷9.5) = 2 per day; actual cycle count = min(3,2) = 2 per day (constrained by time, not by the plan); daily advance = 2.70×2 = 5.40 m; monthly advance at full load = 162 m; a 1000 m schedule ≈ 6.2 months. For comparison: hole depth 4 m, drilling 4 h (rest unchanged) → advance 3.60 m, cycle 10.50 h, 2 per day, daily advance 7.20 m, monthly 216 m, schedule 4.6 months; the short-advance fast-cycle option (hole depth 2 m, η=0.85, drilling 2 h, blasting 0.5 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 2 h, support 1.5 h, planned 4 per day) → advance 1.70 m, cycle 6.50 h, floor(24÷6.5)=3 per day, daily advance 5.10 m, monthly 153 m, schedule 6.5 months.
